description: Source code for DES encryption driver in Linux kernel, implementing DES and 3DES algorithms with various modes (ECB, CBC, OFB, CFB, CTR), including registration and unregistration functions.

methods.name: des_setkey
methods.description: Sets DES key for crypto transformation.

methods.name: des_setkey_skcipher
methods.description: Sets DES key for skcipher transformation.

methods.name: ifx_deu_des
methods.description: Main interface to DES hardware for various modes.

methods.name: ifx_deu_des_ecb
methods.description: Configures DES hardware to ECB mode.

methods.name: ifx_deu_des_cbc
methods.description: Configures DES hardware to CBC mode.

methods.name: ifx_deu_des_ofb
methods.description: Configures DES hardware to OFB mode.

methods.name: ifx_deu_des_cfb
methods.description: Configures DES hardware to CFB mode.

methods.name: ifx_deu_des_ctr
methods.description: Configures DES hardware to CTR mode.

methods.name: ifxdeu_init_des
methods.description: Initializes DES driver and registers algorithms.
